# uptimepage_status_page_section (Resource)

Shows a monitor group on a status page as a live section: a heading with the members' combined state, and each member as its own component. The section mirrors the group, so a monitor that joins the group appears on the page and one that leaves it is taken off. A member already on the page moves into the section with its settings; manage a member's public name and order with uptimepage_status_page_component, which adopts the member's row. Members past the plan's public component limit stay off the page, and the apply warns. Destroying or replacing the section takes its members off the page; a component that adopted one comes back on the next apply. Owner-only.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# uptimepage_monitor_group.dns and uptimepage_target.ns as in the
# uptimepage_monitor_group example.

resource "uptimepage_status_page" "public" {
  slug = "acme"
  name = "Acme Status"
}

# Show the group as a live section: its members follow the group onto and off
# the page, under one heading with their combined state.
resource "uptimepage_status_page_section" "dns" {
  status_page_id = uptimepage_status_page.public.id
  group_id       = uptimepage_monitor_group.dns.id
  heading        = "DNS"
}

# A member's own public name and order. The section already put the monitor
# on the page, so this adopts its row.
resource "uptimepage_status_page_component" "ns" {
  status_page_id = uptimepage_status_page.public.id
  target_id      = uptimepage_target.ns.id
  public_name    = "Nameservers"

  depends_on = [uptimepage_status_page_section.dns]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) Id of the monitor group to show (lowercase UUID). A group has at most one section on a page.
- `status_page_id` (String) Id of the status page (lowercase UUID).

### Optional

- `heading` (String) Public heading, at most 50 characters. Leave it out to show the group's name; set one when that name is operator-facing.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Section id (UUID).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Sections are imported by "status_page_id:section_id", as components are.
terraform import uptimepage_status_page_section.dns 0192f3a4-5b6c-7d8e-9f01-23456789abcd:0192aaaa-bbbb-cccc-dddd-eeeeeeeeeeee
```
